points.en: Alagh Committee (1979): First to define poverty line based on nutritional requirements (2400 kcal rural, 2100 kcal urban).
points.hi: Alagh Committee (1979): First to define poverty line based on nutritional requirements (2400 kcal rural, 2100 kcal urban).

points.en: Lakdawala Committee (1993): Based on state-specific poverty lines using CPI-AL and CPI-IW.
points.hi: Lakdawala Committee (1993): Based on state-specific poverty lines using CPI-AL and CPI-IW.

points.en: Tendulkar Committee (2009): Shifted from calorie-based to uniform poverty line basket (PLB) including health and education.
points.hi: Tendulkar Committee (2009): Shifted from calorie-based to uniform poverty line basket (PLB) including health and education.

points.en: Rangarajan Committee (2014): Recommended higher calorie intake and separate consumption baskets for rural/urban areas.
points.hi: Rangarajan Committee (2014): Recommended higher calorie intake and separate consumption baskets for rural/urban areas.
